image_description: A close-up, high-contrast image featuring a person's lower face (smiling mouth and chin) and neck area. The subject is adorned with multiple thick, silver-colored chains that appear to be fused or draped over pale, smooth, tubular structures resembling stylized bones or synthetic limbs. The chains have a metallic luster but exhibit irregular link shapes and potential structural anomalies where they intersect with the pale objects.
